hadith:
Manumission of Slaves - Narrated Ibn `Umar:

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If a slave is honest and faithful to his master and worships his Lord (Allah) in a perfect manner, he will get a double reward."
message: The Qur’an warns that stinginess and denying the finest reward lead toward hardship, so nurture generosity and trust in Allah’s reward. Allah is Al-‘Aliyy, the Most High; the hadith also teaches that honest, faithful service and sincere worship are greatly rewarded.
name:
Al 'Aliyy - الْعَلِيُّ - The Highest

Al 'Aliyy expresses Allah's exaltedness and supreme greatness. Quran 42:4 pairs the name with Al 'Azeem. The explanation affirms His majesty without comparing Him to the limits of created beings.
verse:
Al-Layl - The Night - 92:8-10

And as for the one who is stingy, indifferent ˹to Allah˺, and ˹staunchly˺ denies the finest reward, We will facilitate for them the path of hardship.
